## Problem

A clear description of the problem or limitation you are facing.

Example: *"I need to support SQL Server views but there is no SQL Server provider."*

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Use Case

Describe the real-world scenario where this feature would be useful.

## Additional Context

Any other context, code samples, or references that would help understand the request.
